# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

PR Summary by Qodo

Add workspace and casual chat creation with bounded agent starts ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Extend new_chat with workspace or casual destinations and draft or approved-start modes.
>• Run approved starts once in the background under shared finite allowances and durable receipts.
>• Preserve drafts and source-chat focus while adding recovery safeguards, migrations, tests, and
>  guidance.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Tool["new_chat tool"] --> Approval["Scoped approval"] --> Creation["Durable chat"] --> Coordinator["Start coordinator"] --> Ledger["Shared allowance"] --> Dispatch["Native dispatch"] --> Receipt["Durable receipt"] Creation --> Receipt ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Separate start_chat tool
- ➕ Separates drafting from execution in the tool interface. - ➖ Duplicates destination creation, approval, and recovery contracts.
2. Use ordinary manual submission
- ➕ Reuses the existing send path. - ➖ Misattributes model-origin work and could replenish its allowance.
3. Share the source chain directly
- ➕ Avoids an allowance-root reference. - ➖ Breaks one-conversation ownership of chains and runs.
>**Recommendation:** Retain the extended `new_chat` tool and separate conversation-local chains linked to one immutable allowance root. The two-store receipt and no-replay rules are warranted by the risk of executing uncertain work twice.

>
>Description >
> >
>ConsoleChatStartCoordinator.accept calls the synchronous accept_chat_start database operation
>directly from an async submission path. When the admission transaction waits on SQLite or takes time
>to complete, it blocks the event loop that handles the console; nearby database work uses
>run_owned_db_call to run off-thread.

>
>Relevance >

>feedback was accepted.

5. A failed background start blocks the chat's automatic work until restart 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability
>
>Description >
> >
>In ConsoleChatStartCoordinator._run, cleanup calls complete_chat_start only when
>item.receipted is true and abort_chat_start only when item.accepted is false, so an attempt
>that was accepted but never got a receipt is never settled in the ledger. This happens when
>commit_durable_turn raises after accept() (including ContinuationAdmissionRefused, where the
>transaction is known to have rolled back) or when confirm_receipt fails. The row then stays
>accepted, its committed generation stays charged to the shared allowance, and _target_active
>refuses every later wake or chat start for that conversation until recover() runs under a new
>runtime owner.

>work.

>confirm_receipt (which sets receipted) never runs. _run then sees `accepted and not

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks

  - Reduces attack surface area
